basic_info.description: Perfectly situated ona prime tree-lined street in Noe Valley,this beautifully reimagined 2 bedroom, 2 bath home offers a rare sophisticated blend of New York-style loft living with 100+ year-old farmhouse charm. Soaring 15 ft ceilings, numerous windows and glass exterior doors capture stunning panoramic city and bay views.The main living space opens to a large deck that extends the living space outdoors, offering the perfect spot to soak in the breathtaking views. These phenomenal views are visible from every room in the home. The open-concept living and dining areas were designed to maximize natural light and highlight the home's architectural beauty. The main level features the great room, living and dining rooms, a bright modern kitchen, bedroom with bay views an updated modern bath and large bonus loft area. The Lower-level en-suite bedroom offers exceptional versatility -it has served as a guest suite, home office, art studio, and even a highly successful Airbnb rental. Large basement storage with new washer/dryer. Nestled in the heart of Noe Valley with access to the neighborhood's finest establishments, beautiful neighborhood parks, and close to 24th street, where charming cafes, top-rated restaurants and boutique shops await. Easy access to MUNI, shuttles and freeways
